scope: By proteomics analysis of the conditioned medium from a glioblastoma cell line treated with a PERK inhibitor

In order to identify secretory proteins regulated by PERK in glioblastoma cells under hypoxia, LN308 cells were cultivated and treated with GSK2606414, a PERK inhibitor, under normoxic or hypoxic conditions for 72 h (Supplementary Fig. S1A). Proteomics analysis of the conditioned media was performed to identify secreted proteins that are regulated by PERK under hypoxia (Fig. 1f).
Proteins in the conditioned media were precipitated using ice cold ethanol followed by in-solution digest with Trypsin.
